svg.title: CaféMesh AI — 05-target-production-architecture
svg.text: Proposed evolution only. Logical capability boundaries do not require a microservice per box.
Load balancing / WAF / rate limits · identity · tenant isolation · RBAC
Cloud Run · controlled tools · request identity and audit context
Only after pilot and partner gates.
Cross-cutting: onboarding and trusted data ownership · consent / export / deletion · security / privacy · backups / restore · SLOs.
Detailed reservations, community, service recovery, forecasts and administration scope is mapped in ARCHITECTURE-AUDIT.md.
